pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit moderate angularity with softened pixel gradients at edges due to low image resolution. Patches on the upper flank are larger and roughly polygonal, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented triangular shapes toward the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous topological network with distinct three-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but appears to widen slightly toward the ventral region.
